prompt: Create a cinematic full-body portrait of a charismatic young vampire nobleman standing in a dark Gothic mansion hall at night. He faces the camera with a confident friendly smile, pale skin, slicked-back dark hair, sharp features, and subtle fangs visible. Dress him in an elegant black Victorian formal suit with a white high collar, black waistcoat, decorative chain brooch, polished black shoes, and a long black cape with a high Dracula-style collar and faint embroidered details. The setting is an opulent old interior with dark carved wood wall panels, deep red velvet curtains, glossy black marble floor with warm reflections, a staircase receding into shadow, ornate gold-framed ancestral portraits on the walls, and exactly three visible candle groupings: one red candelabrum with four lit candles on the left, one tall standing candelabrum with five lit candles behind him, and one gold candelabrum with six lit candles on the right. Use warm candlelight against deep shadows, shallow depth of field, realistic photography, dramatic chiaroscuro, rich burgundy and black tones, vertical composition, centered subject, high detail, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张电影级的全身肖像，主角是一位充满魅力的 年轻吸血鬼贵族，他站在夜晚昏暗的哥特式豪宅大厅中。他面朝镜头，带着自信而友好的微笑，皮肤苍白，留着向后梳的深色头发，五官轮廓分明，隐约可见尖牙。为他穿上一套优雅的黑色维多利亚风格礼服，搭配白色高领衬衫、黑色马甲、装饰性链条胸针、擦得锃亮的黑色皮鞋，以及一件带有德古拉风格高领和精致刺绣细节的黑色长斗篷。场景设定为华丽的古典室内，墙面装饰着深色雕花木板，挂着深红色天鹅绒窗帘，地面是带有暖色倒影的光滑黑色大理石，楼梯隐没在阴影中，墙上挂着装饰华丽的金色边框祖先肖像。画面中必须清晰可见三组蜡烛：左侧是一个带有四支点燃蜡烛的红色烛台，他身后是一个带有五支点燃蜡烛的高大落地烛台，右侧是一个带有六支点燃蜡烛的金色烛台。运用深邃阴影下的暖色烛光，浅景深，写实摄影风格，戏剧性的明暗对比，浓郁的酒红色与黑色调，竖构图，主体居中，高细节，无文字，无水印。
